answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake that thaws like a glacier — slow, over weeks — while its early work is checked against a reef of independent peers: only transactions attested by several unrelated agents earn reputation. A hollow identity with no stake history and no peer attestations can shout, but it cannot spend, vote, or mint; creating a thousand such shells costs a thousand stakes and still buys no trust, because trust accrues only through slow, attested work.
